booking.howItWorks: Fill out the Event Request form on the Events & Parties page and choose a package. The venue gets back to you to confirm. All event and party packages must be booked in advance.

serviceCharge.note: A 20% gratuity will be added to groups of 10 or more.

packages.name: Par Package
packages.description: 2 hours on all 5 simulators with a $100 bar tab. Made for groups of 10 to 30. Each guest beyond 30 is $10 extra.

packages.name: Birdie Package
packages.description: 3 hours on all 5 simulators with a $150 bar tab. Made for groups of 10 to 30. Each guest beyond 30 is $10 extra.

packages.name: Eagle Package
packages.description: 4 hours on all 5 simulators with a $200 bar tab. Made for groups of 10 to 30. Each guest beyond 30 is $10 extra.

packages.name: Simulator Rental - Golf (90+ Courses)
packages.description: Simulator rental to play 90+ golf courses. Up to 8 players per simulator.

packages.name: Simulator Rental - Driving Range
packages.description: Simulator rental on 10+ driving range venues.

packages.name: Simulator Rental - Mini Games / Multi-Sport
packages.description: Simulator rental for mini games and multi-sport (football, soccer, baseball, stick-ball).

packages.name: Senior Discount (Ages 55+)
packages.description: $35 per hour for ages 55+. Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 3:00 PM, holidays excluded.

addOns.name: Additional guest over 30 (party packages)
addOns.description: Each guest beyond 30 on a party package. Example: 35 guests = $50 added.

faq.a: Outside catering is welcome. There is no on-site kitchen, and there is a full bar.

faq.q: How many players fit on a simulator?
faq.a: Up to 8 players per simulator, and there are 5 wide-screen simulators for simultaneous play.

faq.q: What size groups are the party packages for?
faq.a: These packages are designed for groups of 10 to 30 people. For smaller gatherings, please check out our standard bay rental options. More than 30 people? Add $10 per additional guest.

faq.q: Can we rent the whole place for a private event?
faq.a: We welcome large groups and can even close to the public for private events. Hourly shutdown fees apply and must be requested through the contact form.
A 20% gratuity will be added to groups of 10 or more.

faq.q: What else can we play besides golf?
faq.a: Miniature Golf, Darts, Cornhole, and Skee-Ball, plus Multi-Sport (Football, Soccer, Baseball, and Stick-Ball) and 7 Ball Striking Games.

faq.q: Do you have a senior discount?
faq.a: $35 per hour for ages 55+, 9:00 AM to 3:00 PM, Monday to Friday (holidays excluded).

With as few as 8 players, we can create and manage a league for your group. Private leagues are $80 per simulator for 2 hours, or $40 per simulator for 1 hour. They are not available Mondays 6:45pm-9pm, Tuesdays 5:45pm-8pm, Wednesdays 7:15pm-9:30pm, and Thursdays 5:45pm-8pm.
